hero.title: We don't sell trips,
hero.subtitle: Handcrafted, crowd-free experiences across India and beyond — hidden trails, quiet beaches, secret sunsets and small groups that feel like family. You just show up; we make the memories happen.

home.featuredSubtitle: Handpicked escapes our travellers can't stop talking about
home.whySubtitle: Because the best memories are made away from the crowds
home.why1Text: Every trip is designed around moments — sunrise summits, bonfire stories, hidden waterfalls — not checkboxes on a schedule.
home.why2Text: Offbeat trails, quiet stays and smart timing that dodges the tourist rush. No queues, no chaos — just you and the moment.
home.why3Text: Stay, food, travel, permits — everything handled end to end. Your only job is to show up and be happy.
home.why4Text: Transparent prices, expert captains and 4.9★ rated memories. We measure our success in smiles.
home.ctaText: Hundreds of travellers found their escape with us. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll match you with an experience you'll never forget.
home.instaText: Catch live trip moments, traveller stories and new launches on our Instagram.

about.title: About Within Miles
about.subtitle: Born from a love for the road
about.story1: Within Miles started with a simple belief — the best experiences in life are often just within miles of you, waiting to be explored. What began as weekend treks with friends has grown into a travel community that has taken hundreds of travellers across India's mountains, beaches, forts and beyond.
about.story2: Every trip we run is personally curated and led by our team. We handle the logistics, safety and planning — you bring the enthusiasm. From a one-night Sahyadri trek to international escapes, we make group travel easy, safe and unforgettable.
about.mission1Text: Trained leaders, verified stays, first-aid readiness and well-planned routes on every single trip.
about.mission2Text: Solo traveller? You won't be alone for long. Our trips are where friendships begin.
about.mission3Text: We work with local hosts, guides and homestays — your travel supports real communities.
